title: Foxglove Q3 sales summary
brief: Foxglove Garden Centers' retail finance lead, Imani Okoro, needs a Q3 2026 (July to September) sales summary for the store managers, who will mostly read it on their phones. Revenue by category in thousands of dollars. Plants: Jul 820, Aug 760, Sep 910. Tools and supplies: 410, 390, 450. Furniture: 530, 480, 360. Seasonal and holiday: 90, 150, 520. Monthly totals are 1850, 1780 and 2240, which is 5870 for the quarter, up 8.3 percent on the 5420 of the same quarter last year. By category the quarter was: Plants 2490, Tools and supplies 1250, Furniture 1370, Seasonal and holiday 760. Average basket size by month: Jul 38.40 dollars, Aug 39.10, Sep 42.70. Points to draw out: September was the best month, helped by Seasonal and holiday, which reached 23.2 percent of September revenue once autumn displays went up on 2026-09-08; Furniture fell 32.1 percent from July to September as patio season ended, and is the one category that needs a clearance decision; Plants is still the biggest category at 42.4 percent of the quarter. Open with "Q3 at a glance", then "Revenue by category" showing how the mix shifted month by month together with the figures and totals, and "Watch items" with the Furniture clearance decision flagged.

edit.request: The September Furniture figure was restated from 360 to 385, which makes September 2265 and the quarter total 5895.
